tier: Standard tier, short-context columns, no batch / priority discounts; Anthropic cache writes at the 5-minute rate

billing_notes.reasoning_and_thinking: reasoning / thinking tokens are part of the output token count and billed at the output price
billing_notes.openai_cached_input: OpenAI usage: input_tokens already includes the cached part (cached_tokens is a subset), so uncached = input - cached
billing_notes.anthropic_cached_input: Anthropic usage: input_tokens is the uncached part; cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens are reported separately
billing_notes.long_context: only the short-context columns are listed; stoploss.costs refuses to price a call above 128,000 input tokens instead of guessing a long-context rate
